action_items.detail: ffmpeg is not installed (no system binary, imageio-ffmpeg or cv2), so /app/e1_test_reports/videos/fa-che-gameplay.mp4 was NOT created. Only the webm exists. To make the mp4: ffmpeg -i fa-che-gameplay.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart fa-che-gameplay.mp4, then copy it to the path /demo reads.
FPS and audio ducking during owner lines can't be checked headless. With the placeholder ElevenLabs key no owner audio plays (voice log outcome is pending/text-only), so ducking never triggers.

deliverables.video_webm_info: 1280x720, 3m15s, about 44 MB. One continuous run: start screen, typing the name, Kit tutorial, harbour, fly to Wing, 5 typed talk turns (notebook fills HK$600 / Red and gold / Luck and wealth / no white), Ask the market (3 offline cards), arrange 4 flowers with meters, storm, reveal, 3-star score card with HK$440 receipt, then __fache.completeTrucks(['jasmine','fong']) + startFinale parade and the final panel. Checked by playing it back in Chromium at 8x.

notes: 2 stale assertions in the checks were updated (not app bugs). harbour-camera-trucks expected the P1 'help Uncle Wing first' lock, which P4 removed (trucks open in any order). research-arrange-meters used the old testid intel-offline-label and now uses intel-panel-label; it counts .intel-card elements because the intel-card-* prefix also matches intel-card-label-*.

The first run of p3 flagged an 'X-API-Key' string in a third-party injected script. The scan now covers only the app /static/js bundles. The bundle has no YDC_API_KEY, and no ydc/you.com requests were seen.
The WebSocket ws://localhost:443/ws console errors come from the dev server HMR and are harmless.
